subject: Island space: final config, hanging signage spec & shipping window
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@convergesummit.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marco@eventops.co
Date: 2026-10-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Island allocation confirmed — need dims & signage intent

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Thanks again for confirming your island space in Hall C (island C5). Attached is the official floor diagram from show management (converge_island_diagram_v1.pdf). A few items we need to lock down by Nov 9 so we can publish the exhibitor map: 

- Final island configuration (we need 3 layout options; a/b/c) — include exact exposed edge lengths.
- Hanging signage: max diameter 4m, rigging point cost estimate if you want a center halo.
- Power needs: total kW and distribution (is there a hardwired AV rack?).
- Shipping window: early crates can arrive Nov 15–18; late freight Nov 19–21 (higher surcharge).

Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the signage proof and the crate packing list? Also send any higher-res art for approvals.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Senior Exhibit Manager — Converge Cloud Summit
attachments: converge_island_diagram_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena@convergesummit.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-03T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Island allocation confirmed — need dims & signage intent

Elena — thanks for the diagram. We reviewed with the events team and here are our commitments and asks: 

1) Layout: attaching our marked-up plan (exhibit_island_drawing_v3.pdf). We prefer Option B (corner demo bay + lounge + demo counter). Exposed edge lengths: 12' front demo, 10' left, 10' right.

2) Hanging signage: we want a 3.2m circular halo centered over the island. Please confirm ceiling height clearance (is 7.5m available?). If rigging requires a structural attachment we'll need cost estimate to evaluate.

3) Power/AV: we will have one hard rack (2U server + switch) and two AV drops. Estimated electrical draw: 2.8 kW peak. I'll route the official electrical order once I get the DocuSign link.

4) Shipping: we will aim for early window (Nov 15–18) to avoid surcharge. I’ll circulate the crate packing list and palletization plan to logistics.

Owners: Ben will own signage proofs and final art sign-off (ben_cc). Laura will own collateral orders and swag inventory (laura_cc). Grace will coordinate freight and on-site setup (grace_cc).

Next steps: Ben — please take the signage task. Laura — update the swag list and add estimated weights. I’ll follow up with Marco about rigging constraints.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Field Marketing Lead — Redwood Inference
attachments: exhibit_island_drawing_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Marco Ruiz <marco@eventops.co>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, Elena Park <elena@convergesummit.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-05T14:48:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Island allocation confirmed — need dims & signage intent

Mateo — quick clarifications from rigging/ops: 

- Ceiling clearance in Hall C is 9.0m at center, 7.0m near the aisles. A 3.2m halo centered over island C5 is acceptable but we must hang it at the center point only (no asymmetric rigging).
- Load limit at the center truss is 400 kg; halo weight estimate needed.
- If you use a hanging sign, you must submit stamped structural drawings by Nov 12.
- Shipping window: Nov 15–18 is considered "early" and will be unloaded into an assigned dock. Any crates arriving Nov 19–21 will be handled but charged express handling (approx +18%).

Electrical: please sign the electrical order — DocuSign link below — to reserve two dedicated AV drops and one 20A circuit: 
https://app.docusign.com/link/electrical-order-CCS-2026

Let me know if you want an onsite rigging walkthrough on Nov 16 (we can book a 30 min slot).

Cheers,
Marco Ruiz
Operations Lead — EventOps
attachments: n/a

Hi Sara — forwarding the thread with the final preferred layout (Option B). Ben will own signage art approvals but I'm sending the initial specs so you can quote and confirm lead times: 

Signage brief: 3.2m circular halo, single-sided vinyl with internal LED wash, matte finish. Vector artwork attached (signage_artwork_v3.ai). We need proof by Nov 13 to meet printing deadlines for Nov 15 shipment. Please confirm: 
- Proof turnaround (hours) once you receive AI file
- Fabrication lead time (days)
- Packaging and crate dimensions for logistics planning
- Any rigging hardware you require vs. what the venue provides

Attachments: signage_artwork_v3.ai, swag_production_list.xlsx

Thanks,
Mateo
